purpose: Bind preserved-review discussion reads and explicit writes to the original authenticated principal and scope, expose edit conflicts accurately, and purge on a focus probe that observes an authority change.

contract.encoding: Exact lowercase 64-hex accessRevision from meta[name=sf-access-revision].content; no JSON, base64 or browser-produced identity.
contract.request: The owned client sends the initial access revision on all discussion POSTs and requires a successful recipients read with a matching echo before mutation. A present malformed or different expected revision receives HTTP403 before route invocation.
contract.success: An admitted collaboration result echoes the admitted accessRevision when the request supplied the header. The review-thread-context route echoes it on success. The client accepts successful data only if the echo matches its original revision and its view generation is live.
contract.compatibility: Header absence preserves existing consumers. The new Reports client fails closed without a matching echo and therefore cannot mutate against an unpatched C6 boundary.
contract.authority: The header selects an expected identity; it never grants access or replaces current admission, C05/source/recipient authorization, C08 CAS, human intent or final release checks.

provenance.fact: accessRevision digest includes installationId, projectId, principalRef, roles, scopes, canWrite, namespaces, operations, humanActions and policyVersion.
documentHtml writes sf-access-revision meta; shell refresh compares the matching response header.
C08 replay checks the authenticated principal/namespace/target/key, command identity and current authority before returning the durable result without executing the write callback.

application.method: Compare all current blobs with preimage_blob at one coherent candidate, then apply the complete diff through the owner's normal GitHub MCP CAS path. If any preimage differs, reconcile with that owner's current candidate before editing.
application.approval: This bundle is a proposed input. It does not claim session33 consumption, permission to merge, deployment or acceptance.
application.artifact_format: Complete source images use .ts.txt suffixes and are inert documentation; path remains the real .ts application target.

verification.remote_tests: NOT_RUN_FOR_SHARED_PATCH: session33 must execute surgical existing-dispatcher gates after consumption
verification.performed: Preimage Git blob and postimage SHA256/Git blob identity plus complete unified diff generated as artifact processing only.
required: Old expected revision under an independently changed authenticated principal or scope is rejected before invoking reads or writes.
Matching admitted revision returns the exact X-SF-Review-Binding echo; no header consumer remains compatible.
Reply response loss retains the original serialized payload and idempotency key; authorized reconciliation alone performs no write; retry is explicit and C08 does not append twice.
Thread edit CAS returns conflict/product-state-changed rather than unavailable; denied read/commit/final-reread results reach HTTP403.
Focus probe with changed or missing revision on HTTP2xx clears the view and dispatches sf-access-revoked; network/HTTP5xx does not manufacture a denial.
Run the four nominal Reports E2Es over the owner's real composed candidate; do not replace them with a browser bundle check.

limitations: C6 lacks a distinct real recipient authority and some external C05 source authorities. This patch does not provide principals, provider identity, ACL, native witness or test-only grants.
Existing thread readers may report source/recipient unavailability as HTTP503; callers must not infer current authorization from a generic unavailable result.

Existing edit replay after a later edit may remain unavailable because the producer requires the committed version to be current. The original key remains safe against duplicate writes; this patch adds no receipt lookup or automatic resend.
These pre/post images are proposed shared code stored only inside mission-owned receipts. All shared production paths remain read-only.
